questions.question: Decision 0025 makes the Postgres settings_revisions table authoritative over settings.yaml, but reading it requires Postgres to be up — while the spec also says nothing destructive/mutating runs before authority checks pass. How should startup resolve this chicken-and-egg?

The implementation exposes undocumented `local status`/`local doctor` (duplicating existing top-level `gantry status`/`gantry doctor`), and bare `gantry local` silently starts the whole dev stack instead of doing nothing. Fix this CLI surface now?
options: Remove duplicates, bare command prints usage (Recommended)
questions.chosen: Remove duplicates, bare command prints usage (Recommended)

questions.question: The one-time authorization link is a 10-minute admin credential. Right now it always prints to inherited stdout, so shell redirection, IDE task logs, or CI capture could persist it — contradicting the no-token-in-evidence rule.

Preflight-then-destroy ordering (already decided) prevents refusal-after-partial-mutation, but does nothing for a crash that happens AFTER the DB schema commit and BEFORE filesystem cleanup finishes — that leaves mixed old/new state with no way to detect or resume it.
options: Add a durable reset-in-progress marker now (Recommended)
questions.chosen: Add a durable reset-in-progress marker now (Recommended)
